structured.notesForReview:
BLOCKER for fixer-A (src/assets/styles/notion.css, not mine): every `.text--*` remap there is inert. notion.css:174/178/185 use `html .v-application .text--primary|secondary|disabled` = specificity (0,2,1)+!important, but Vuetify's own sheet (generated by `+theme(v-application)` in node_modules/vuetify/src/components/VApp/VApp.sass, pulled in via the per-component sass imports — there is no vuetify/dist CSS import) emits `.theme--light.v-application .text--primary|secondary|disabled` = (0,3,0)+!important, which wins. So app-wide those helpers still paint rgba(0,0,0,.87/.6/.38) instead of the Notion inks, and `.text--disabled` (used in ~dozens of readouts) is ~2.7:1 on white. Fix = add the theme class to the anchor, e.g. `html .v-application.theme--light .text--disabled, .v-application.theme--light .text--disabled` (0,3,1). I worked around it locally only for ConsoleTableEntry.

OTHER:
1) notion.css:1276 `.select-printer-dialog .v-btn.white--text` is now dead (template dropped color="white") — keep as defence for other dialogs or remove; don't re-add a `white` palette key.
2) TheSelectPrinterDialog still ships the bare `toolbar` class on each printer v-col (line ~197) and `toolbar-color="toolbar"` on Panel. Both are inert now that all custom keys are notion*-prefixed, and notion.css:1281-1289 styles those rows via `.v-col.toolbar` — do NOT rename the class without editing notion.css in the same change.
3) App.vue `@Watch('mode')` (line 221) is still not `{ immediate: true }`, which is the root cause of the html-class problem; adding it is a script change and rule 1 forbade it, so everything stays dual-anchored/ungated. Worth a human decision for the PR.
4) Light `primary` in vuetify.ts can be replaced at runtime by App.vue's `@Watch('primaryColor')` when a user persisted a custom accent (documented in the file); fresh/default installs keep #1a73d1. defaultPrimaryColor stays '#2383e2' — reverting it would undo the reskin accent, but it does flip the SettingsUiSettingsTab 'reset to default' affordance for installs that had #2196f3; call that out in the PR (same class of issue as the thumbnail constant).
5) Not fixed (would be computed-semantics/script changes, rule 1): TemperaturePanelListItem.vue:167 and TemperaturePanelListItemNevermore.vue:70 fall back to '#FFFFFF'/'#ffffff' for the series colour (invisible white dot on the white panel), and src/store/variables.ts:19-24 (colorArray, colorHeaterBed #2196F3, colorChamber #4CAF50, opacityHeaterInactive '44' = 27%) are still dark-canvas tuned, incl. the random `'#'+Math.floor(...)` colour. Needs a decision on whether the fallback or the tempHistory dataset getter should change.
6) Pre-existing (untouched HEAD) files under src/components/ still gate light-mode ink on `html.theme--light` alone and therefore never land: Mmu/MmuFilamentStatusEncoder.vue:63,71; Mmu/MmuFilamentStatusSensor.vue:81,89,97,105; Mmu/MmuUnitFooter.vue:142; Mmu/MmuUnit.vue:101; dialogs/MmuEditTtgMapDialogTool.vue:78; webcams/WebcamWrapperItem.vue:89; webcams/streamers/Mjpegstreamer*.vue.
